Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ الْأَوَّلِ قَبْلَ الْإِنْشَاءِ وَالْإِحْيَاءِ
Translation: All praise be to Allah, the First before creation and giving life
And the Last after the annihilation of all things
The All-Knowing who does not forget those who remember Him
And does not reduce the reward of those who thank Him
And does not disappoint those who call upon Him
And does not cut off the hope of those who hope in Him
O Allah, I call You to witness
And You are sufficient as a witness
And I call to witness all Your angels
And the inhabitants of Your heavens
And the bearers of Your Throne

Arabic text: وَمَنْ بَعَثْتَ مِنْ أَنْبِيَائِكَ وَ رُسُلِكَ
Translation: And those whom You have sent from Your prophets and messengers
And created from the varieties of Your creation
That I bear witness that You are Allah
There is no god except You alone

Arabic text: لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ وَ لَا عَدِيلَ
Translation: You have no partner and no equal
And there is no breaking of Your word and no changing

Arabic text: وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ عَبْدُكَ وَرَسُولُكَ
Translation: And that Muhammad, peace be upon him and his family, is Your servant and messenger
He delivered what You entrusted him with to the servants

Arabic text: وَجَاهَدَ فِيْ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ حَقَّ الْجِهَادِ
Translation: And he strived in the way of Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, with true striving

Arabic text: وَأَنَّهُ بَشَّرَ بِمَا هُوَ حَقٌّ مِنَ الثَّوَابِ
Translation: And he gave glad tidings of what is true of the reward

Arabic text: وَأَنْذَرَ بِمَا هُوَ صِدْقٌ مِنَ الْعِقَابِ
Translation: And warned of what is true of the punishment

Arabic text: اَللّٰهُمَّ ثَبِّتْنِيْ عَلَى دِينِكَ مَا أَحْيَيْتَنِي
Translation: O Allah, keep me firm on Your religion as long as You keep me alive

Arabic text: وَلَا تُزِغْ قَلْبِىْ بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَيْتَنِي
Translation: And do not let my heart deviate after You have guided me
And grant me mercy from Your presence
Indeed, You are the Bestower

Arabic text: صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلٰى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: Send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad
And make me among his followers and his Shia
And gather me in his company
And grant me success in performing the obligation of Friday prayers

Arabic text: وَمَا أَوْجَبْتَ عَلَيَّ فِيهَا مِنَ الطَّاعَاتِ
Translation: And what You have made obligatory upon me of acts of obedience
And what You have apportioned for its people of gifts
On the Day of Recompense
Indeed, You are the Mighty, the Wise
